patient._comment: 'patient' contains the three sections that may be exposed in the detailed patient display: presentation, answer, and clinical.

presentation._comment: The immutable patient evidence package available for triage. Panel context controls whether other sections are locked or available.
presentation.quote: It was the deck railing. Mom tried tweezers, I said some words I'm not allowed to say, and now we're here.
presentation.triageNote: 12-year-old male with a wooden splinter embedded under the fingernail for three hours, neurovascularly intact with no signs of infection.

answer._comment: The authoritative game answer. Explicit ESI, destination, and destination rationale are answer-bearing content; the player's assignment remains session state.
answer.destinationReason: ESI 4 is appropriate because this stable subungual wooden foreign body requires one procedure for removal under local anesthesia.

clinical._comment: Display-ready clinical interpretation derived from patient.presentation. It preserves clinical meaning but must not explicitly name or identify the correct ESI level or destination; it does not participate in scoring.
clinical.summary: This child has a recent wooden splinter beneath the nail with intact distal function and no infection.
clinical.acuityReason: This stable subungual wooden foreign body requires one procedure for removal under local anesthesia.
teachingPoints: One procedure under local anaesthetic. Wood must come out — it is highly inflammatory and will not be quietly tolerated the way glass or metal sometimes is.
Triage should be based on the current presentation and expected care, with reassessment if new warning signs appear.

possibleClinicalOutcome.disposition: Removal, cleansing, and wound and tetanus guidance would allow discharge.

aiImageGeneration._comment: 'aiImageGeneration' is info for AI to generate the image of the patient. Most images were done with openAI gpt-image-1 using an API, not the app, in July 2026. Look for some python scripts that are used to create these images. Be sure that the anchor-image is available and is provided to the AI - otherwise the images will not be consistent.

aiImageGeneration.prompt: Softly-shaded painterly cartoon illustration in a semi-realistic Pixar/Disney style: smooth gradient shading, soft natural lighting, gentle rounded volumes, fine delicate outlines (NOT thick flat cartoon outlines), warm detailed rendering, natural realistic proportions, single character. Match the painterly STYLE of the attached reference image - its brushwork, shading, line weight, lighting and palette - but do NOT copy its cropping, camera distance or composition. FRAMING (follow exactly): a full-body WIDE SHOT, square 1:1, 3/4 front view, subject centred. The ENTIRE figure must be inside the frame from the top of the head to the soles of both feet, and the ENTIRE chair must be inside the frame including all four chair legs meeting the floor. Leave clear empty margin on all four sides - roughly 10% of the image width as space above the head and below the feet. This is NOT a close-up, NOT a bust, NOT a head-and-shoulders portrait, NOT a cropped view: the camera is pulled well back so the whole person and the whole chair sit comfortably inside the picture with room around them. Draw the COMPLETE body - head, neck, torso, both arms, both hands, lap, both legs, both feet with shoes. Nothing cropped by the edges, no missing or truncated limbs, no body part fading out or left unfinished. Subject: a white 12-year-old boy in a t-shirt and shorts, seated on a blue padded clinic chair. Pose: sitting holding one hand out in front of him, index finger extended, looking away from it. Expression: dramatically brave, wincing theatrically. Clearly visible: one index fingertip held out with a dark splinter visible under the nail; the other hand gripping the chair. Overall: entirely well, very invested in the drama. No text, no logos, no watermarks, no border.
